decisions.reason: The cleaning centrifuge complements the firm's filtration systems at low holding cost, and two years of market presence still leave its demand uncertain, so the option is worth keeping open.
Coolant nozzles are a cheap accessory line with several models that supports system sales, so keeping the option costs little relative to its potential.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a core part of the conveyor offer with steady metalworking demand, and nothing suggests their value will go unrealized.
The magnetic belt conveyor shares the established conveyor platform, so keeping it adds little cost while its prospects continue to develop.
Hinged belt chip conveyors are a standard product type for machine tool users that supports the modular offering at minimal extra cost.
